displayName: Alfalfa and Potatoes or Snap Beans (keep apart: potato leafhopper)

keepApart.reason: Potato leafhoppers leave alfalfa when it is cut and move to nearby snap beans and potatoes
keepApart.source: University of Wisconsin Garden Facts XHT1132, David M. Lowenstein and Russell L. Groves, "Potato Leafhopper" (revised 2020-05-06), https://hort.extension.wisc.edu/files/2014/11/Potato-Leafhoppers.pdf
